headline: Amul And Mother Dairy Announce Milk Price Hikes Across India
seoTitle: Major Milk Brands Increase Prices Nationwide
metaDescription: Leading Indian dairy brands Amul and Mother Dairy have increased milk prices by up to six rupees per litre, citing rising production and input costs.
aiSummaryBullets: Amul has increased the retail price of milk by two to four rupees per litre.
Mother Dairy is implementing price adjustments of up to six rupees per litre.
The companies cited rising input costs and supply constraints as primary drivers.
aiContextParagraph: Major dairy cooperatives Amul and Mother Dairy have announced an upcoming increase in milk retail prices, effective November 12, 2026. The price adjustments, which range from two to six rupees per litre across different milk variants, will impact consumers in the Delhi-NCR region and beyond. Industry reports attribute these cost increases to a combination of factors affecting the dairy sector. Specifically, the producers identified significantly higher expenses related to the production and processing of milk as a major factor. Furthermore, the companies noted that a decrease in overall milk supply, compounded by the broader impact of inflation, has necessitated these price changes to maintain operations. This decision follows ongoing challenges within the agricultural supply chain that have affected the production costs of essential dairy commodities throughout the Indian market.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to the coordinated price increases by two major dairy suppliers, as reflected by coverage from multiple national news outlets.
